memory_accounting.descriptor_scope: Native shared allocation descriptor / reserved VMM address capacity; not physically committed bytes and not a PyTorch caching-allocator allocation.
memory_accounting.precision: GiB values are rounded to two decimal places in verified startup logs; they are not exact byte counters.
memory_accounting.allocator_scope: The reported allocated/reserved/peak fields are PyTorch caching-allocator counters. Externally managed KV VMM commitment is separate and must not be assumed included.
memory_accounting.total_peak_scope: No exact per-forward all-allocator device-memory peak was measured. Do not sum a noncontemporaneous rounded startup KV commitment with PyTorch peaks and label it a measured total.

limitations: Exactly one pretrained inference model; no training, backward-pass or multiple-model-size evaluation.
Profile timings are diagnostic and excluded from latency headlines.
Kernel category labels are conservative symbol-name heuristics; fused kernels can span several operations.
Cumulative kernel durations describe work and may overlap. Kernel union coverage is computed separately within each process/device measured range; GPUs are never summed into elapsed time.
No-kernel gaps can contain memory copies, CPU dispatch, synchronization or untraced work. They are not proven GPU idle time or HBM saturation measurements.
Native sequence parallelism can activate at 2048 input tokens; same configuration does not mean the same algorithm at every context length.

PyTorch allocated/reserved/peak counters exclude separately managed KV VMM commitment. Cache descriptor/address capacity, rounded startup committed GiB, logical payload and snapshot bytes are different quantities; no exact per-forward all-allocator device-memory peak is claimed.
Full-history pages are reserved by the direct harness; native window read limits remain1024 attention/4 convolution, and production eviction is not simulated.
4096 is a tested context, not a maximum fitting context.
recommendation: Next, attribute and benchmark the native SM103 relative-bias un-shearing helper, then test an exact fused implementation if the attribution holds. At 4096-token prefill, observed gather+where kernel classes occupy 27.54–27.57 ms per GPU (20.4% of the instrumented range), while total kernel coverage is 98.6%. This is an observed optimization opportunity, not a predicted latency saving. Decode is nearly flat across history lengths and has no-kernel intervals consistent with dispatch/peer-arrival effects; calibrating its existing serving CUDA-graph path is diagnostic, not a new serving optimization.
